scope: Full tracked checkout; complete model and MCP decorator inventories with targeted static lifecycle, token/session, persistence, advisory reservations, stale cleanup, HTTP role/browser write, archive sequencing, representative template and selected test assertion review. Not every-line audit; no CLI/export/full viewer/complete attachment or alternate database certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Project row unique slug/retry; agent profile and registration token, existing identity authentication; durable mail creation rather than task creation
lifecycle_review.select: No ready-task queue; external ticket key can be used as thread/reason; inbox and search support coordination only
lifecycle_review.claim: BEGIN IMMEDIATE reservation read/check/write returns both grants and conflicts; optional slots also advisory and suppress file-write errors; no exclusive task claim
lifecycle_review.progress: Authenticated sender, per-project message/recipient transaction, separate archive bundle, partial multi-project delivery results; mutable agent focus separate from durable messages
lifecycle_review.review: No task acceptance/reviewer contract; authenticated recipient read/ack state indicates receipt only
lifecycle_review.complete: External task authority required; release reservations and send a result do not enforce dependencies, children or accepted work
lifecycle_review.cancel: Self-owned reservation release, agent retirement and project archival exist as coordination state; no worker execution cancellation
lifecycle_review.recover: TTL/heuristic stale reservation and orphan cleanup, session reauthentication, unread polling, conditional receipts and best-effort DB compensation; browser writer retains DB state after archive failure; no durable operation journal or attempt fence
